preconditions.description: The size of the broom is between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in the edges are within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(len(xi) == 1 and 'a' <= xi <= 'z' for _, _, xi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge labels are single lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The minimum possible size of the broom is at least 1.
The chosen integer p is within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: any(len(word) >= p for word in words)
postconditions.description: There is at least one word of length at least p.

postconditions.expression: min_broom_size == min(size_of_simplified_broom(p) for p in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The minimum possible size of the broom is achieved by the optimal choice of p.
